title: Guyana Ferry Tragedy Exposes Political Rifts in Oil-Rich Country
summary_full: The capsizing of a ferry was Guyana’s deadliest event since Jonestown in 1978. Many are asking how this could happen in one of the world’s fastest-growing economies.
